habits.boundary_condition: Treat this as a durable amenity preference, not a destination-, date-, party-size-, or price-specific requirement. Do not infer indoor versus outdoor pool preference unless the user states it for the current trip.
habits.condition: When choosing or evaluating a hotel for a stay
habits.default_action: Prioritize hotel options that include all three wellness/recreation amenities: pool, hot tub, and fitness center or comparable place to exercise.
habits.exception_condition: Relax or ask for clarification if no suitable hotel offers all three amenities, or if the user explicitly deprioritizes recreation or exercise amenities for the current booking.
habits.name: prefers_hotels_with_pool_hot_tub_and_fitness_options
habits.preference_value: Hotels that offer a pool, a hot tub, and a fitness or exercise facility
habits.rationale: Across three independent hotel dialogues, the user repeatedly asks for the same combination of hotel recreation and exercise amenities: pool, hot tub, and a fitness or exercise facility.

source_evidence.contribution: Directly states the full amenity combination as a hotel requirement.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: The hotel must have a pool with a hot tub and a fitness center.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently requests the same pool, hot tub, and fitness center combination at the hotel.
